mentions.name: General Problem Solver
mentions.description: This is an AI-driven "general problem solver" (planned to focus on math problems first) built around an orchestrator that directs and structures the problem-solving approach based on the number of rounds remaining and other problem context, influencing the behavior of specialist LLM agents. You initialize it with an objective and a number of rounds; specialists apply patches to named artifacts (e.g. uncertainties, dead ends, findings) each round, which are injected into prompts in subsequent rounds instead of accumulating a single long context. It supports manually stepping one round at a time or running continuously, and the Rust engine ships with a web UI, CLI, and a config editor for defining specialists, artifact sets, and orchestrator prompting.
